from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import issue_credit_note
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

def inv(total="1000.00", status="issued"):
    return Invoice("i", "c", lines=[LineItem("x", 1, Decimal(total))], status=status)

# <=500 no approval
print(issue_credit_note(inv(), Decimal("500.00"), "ok"))
# >500 no approval
try:
    issue_credit_note(inv(), Decimal("500.01"), "x")
except BillingError as e:
    print("raised", e.code)
# >500 with approval
print(issue_credit_note(inv(), Decimal("600.00"), "x", approved_by="mgr"))
# exceeds total
try:
    issue_credit_note(inv("100.00"), Decimal("200.00"), "x")
except BillingError as e:
    print("raised", e.code)
# not issued
try:
    issue_credit_note(inv(status="draft"), Decimal("1.00"), "x")
except BillingError as e:
    print("raised", e.code)
# float rejected
try:
    issue_credit_note(inv(), 10.0, "x")
except BillingError as e:
    print("raised", e.code)
